results.title: Cannavaro assesses national team's condition ahead of the World Cup – Zamin.uz, 12.05.2026
highlights:
Uzbekistan national team head coach Fabio Cannavaro spoke in detail at a press conference about the team's preparation, physical condition, squad selection, and plans ahead of the World Cup. The Italian specialist indicated that the national team is undergoing serious and systematic preparation for this historic tournament.
[...]
Cannavaro first addressed the players' physical condition. He noted that because the domestic league's tempo does not fully match World Cup standards, the competition was temporarily paused in agreement with the league, and the team has entered a specialized physical training phase.
[...]
The specialist also commented on the inclusion of players with limited match practice. He stated that these decisions were made in consultation with the coaching staff and experts. Cannavaro noted that he has been monitoring players like Husayn Norchaev and Abbosbek Fayzullayev, and even though their current match practice is low, they could benefit the team at the World Cup.
[...]
The Italian coach also clarified his previous statement about needing “warrior players.” According to him, opponents at the World Cup will be very strong, so players must enter the pitch fearless, mentally resilient, and physically prepared.
[...]

[...]

[...]
The coach also announced that serious work is being done on set-pieces. In modern football, corner kicks, free kicks, and other set-pieces can decide the fate of a match. Cannavaro stated that 15–20 goals per season can be scored from set-pieces, and significant attention is being paid to this area.
[...]
The selection of opponents for friendly matches was not accidental. Cannavaro said that Canada and the Netherlands were chosen in consultation with the coaching staff and UFA representatives. Canada offers an environment that needs to be studied as a World Cup host, while the Netherlands resembles Portugal in terms of playing style and physical preparation.
[...]
This allows the Uzbekistan national team to prepare better against group stage opponents. Cannavaro noted that there were other options, but the coaching staff considered these two opponents the most suitable.
[...]
Overall, one can conclude from Cannavaro's comments that the team's preparation is proceeding seriously. Physical condition, set-pieces, opponent analysis, and mental preparation are all being carried out based on a specific plan.
[...]
This is the first World Cup for Uzbekistan. Therefore, the path will not be easy. But as Cannavaro said, the main thing is not to be afraid, to give everything on the pitch, and to defend the honor of our people worthily. The World Cup is a big stage. Now our players are preparing to make their mark on that stage.

results.title: Uzbekistan FIFA World Cup 2026 preview: Player to watch out for, tactics, predicted playing XI - Sportstar
highlights:
Uzbekistan FIFA World Cup 2026 preview: Player to watch out for, tactics, predicted playing XI - Sportstar
[...]
# Uzbekistan FIFA World Cup 2026 preview: Cannavaro’s White Wolves aim to make a splash
[...]
## Fabio Cannvaro will hope he can transfer his experience of the big stage onto the youthful Uzbek group who will have no fear of failure.
[...]
Uzbekistan has already created history by qualifying for the World Cup for the first time ever. The side excelled in the second and third rounds of AFC qualifying, losing just a solitary game, to book its tickets to the World Cup.
[...]
Despite Timur Kapadze leading the team into its maiden World Cup, the White Wolves have opted to go a different route to wade through the pressure of the tournament, appointing Fabio Cannavaro as the head coach in 2025. The 2006 World Cup-winning captain will hope he can transfer his experience of the big stage onto the youthful Uzbek group who will have no fear of failure.
[...]
Uzbekistan deploys a three-man central defence and is a team built on solidity and physical presence. The player and the manager pride themselves on being difficult to break down and the Central Asian nation will look to be thorn in the side of the bigger teams in the group.
[...]
#### Player to watch out for
[...]
Abdukodir Khusanov: The 22-year-old defender has had a breakout year in Manchester City blue, deputising admirably well for the injured Ruben Dias. He has already accumulated 25 caps for his nation and will look to be a leader on the pitch in its first World Cup appearance.
[...]
Not many managers at this World Cup can boast about being Ballon d’Or winners. In fact Cannavaro is the only one who can stake a claim. The Italian legend started his coaching career in the top Asian leagues and took over Uzbekistan after a brief 14-game stay at Dinamo Zagreb of Croatia where it beat his old nemesis AC Milan in the group stage.
[...]
